name: Yasha
source: [spoiler]Rinko said that she has similarity with [url=https://vndb.org/c43638]Momo[/url] or even the person herself. This fact is rejected by Yasha and said that she is the form of regret from Momo. Under her mask is Hozumi Chihaya (穂積千早); she is Momo's older sister.[/spoiler]
